title: Orbit Guard
tagline: Spin the shield, catch the space sprinkles!
description: Spin a rainbow shield around a friendly little planet so every space sprinkle lands on the arc of its own colour.
how_to: Drag around the planet to spin the shield
Or tap the left or right side to turn it one step
Catch each sprinkle with the arc of the same colour and shape
Wrong colour costs a heart. Grab golden stars for bonus points
